subject: Vulnerability report request + SLA & scanning cadence — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@acme-corp.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: security materials & pen-test report request

Hi Julia — great to meet yesterday. Thanks for the time and for walking through Acme's primary regulatory concerns (GDPR + HIPAA scope for the product team). Per our discovery, two quick asks from your security team that we want to turn into a short mutual action plan: (1) access to Redwood's most recent penetration test results / summary, (2) confirmation of SOC 2 status and where we can retrieve evidence, and (3) vendor security questionnaire kickoff.

I've attached a short executive summary of Redwood's last independent pen test (redwood_pen_test_summary_2025.pdf) and a suggested vulnerability SLA and scanning cadence (vuln-sla-proposal.xlsx) to give you our recommended starting point. High-level proposals inside:
- Pen test frequency: annual third-party pen test + quarterly internal scans
- Scanning cadence: weekly authenticated scans for production services, nightly unauthenticated surface scans
- Vulnerability SLA (proposed): Critical = 72 hours, High = 7 days, Medium = 30 days, Low = 90 days
- Disclosure: coordinated disclosure channel + redaction process for PII in reports; full reports available via secure link or NDA as needed

Next steps I propose:
1) Can you confirm whether Acme needs the full redacted report (PDF) or the exec summary only?
2) Does Acme have an existing commercial NDA we prefer, or should we provide our standard mutual NDA for the report transfer?
3) Please share the vendor questionnaire PDF or a HubSpot link and a primary POC for security; we can start filling items we can answer right away.

If that works, I'll loop in Monica from our security/CS team and Diego from solutions to own the questionnaire and provide SOC 2 artifacts. Happy to book a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through any gaps.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_2025.pdf, vuln-sla-proposal.xlsx
From: Julia Morris <julia.morris@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security materials & pen-test report request

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary. Quick answers:
- Acme will need the full redacted pen-test report (we cannot accept only an exec summary for vendor risk teams).
- We have a standard vendor NDA (attached in HubSpot under the deal), but we can accept Redwood's mutual NDA if easier.
- I'll be the primary POC for the questionnaire; security@acme-corp.com should be included for any technical clarifications.

Timebox for us: we need the report and SOC 2 evidence by Apr 12 to keep this Q2 procurement timeline on track. Also, please confirm the remediation SLA you propose for critical findings — our procurement team typically needs <72 hours for critical fixes or a compensating control plan.

I'll upload the vendor questionnaire to the HubSpot deal and assign it to you. Expect a note from our procurement lead if we need any contract redlines.

—Julia
Julia Morris
Senior Product Security Manager, Acme Corp
julia.morris@acme-corp.com

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 08:20:00 -07:00

On Apr 4, 2026, at 11:05 AM, Julia Morris <julia.morris@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — helpful summary. Quick answers:
> - Acme will need the full redacted pen-test report (we cannot accept only an exec summary for vendor risk teams).
> - We have a standard vendor NDA (attached in HubSpot under the deal), but we can accept Redwood's mutual NDA if easier.
> - I'll be the primary POC for the questionnaire; security@acme-corp.com should be included for any technical clarifications.
> 
> Timebox for us: we need the report and SOC 2 evidence by Apr 12 to keep this Q2 procurement timeline on track. Also, please confirm the remediation SLA you propose for critical findings — our procurement team typically needs <72 hours for critical fixes or a compensating control plan.

Thanks for the clarity — looping in Monica (security/compliance lead) and Diego (solutions).

Monica: below is Acme's ask. Quick summary of what we can provide and how:
- Pen test report: we can provide the full redacted third-party report via a secure, expiring link after a quick mutual NDA (we also offer per-request redaction to remove customer PII). We will not publish raw exploit data publicly; transfers are via secure document portal.
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified; our control set and latest Attestation can be shared through our secure evidence bucket. Monica will push the SOC 2 Attestation + scope docs to an S3 link (read-only).
- Vulnerability SLA & cadence: we are aligned with the proposed ranges but can confirm final SLAs below:
  • Critical: 72 hours (mitigation or documented compensating control + mitigation plan)
  • High: 7 business days
  • Medium: 30 calendar days
  • Low: 90 calendar days
- Scanning cadence we propose: weekly authenticated scans against prod, nightly unauthenticated scans, monthly dependency scans, quarterly third-party pen test. Continuous monitoring/alerting for critical CVEs.

Next steps/action items: 
1) We will prepare an NDA template if you prefer Redwood's. Otherwise, please attach Acme's NDA in HubSpot and we'll sign. (Owner: Karthik) — target: Apr 6
2) Monica to upload SOC 2 artifacts and provide the secure link for the pen-test PDF (Owner: Monica) — target: Apr 7
3) Diego to start answering the HubSpot vendor questionnaire and return initial answers (Owner: Diego) — target: Apr 9
4) Scheduling: 30-min sync week of Apr 6 to walk through any open items (I'll send a Doodle if that times looks good).

If Acme absolutely requires remediation <72 hours for critical items, our suggested approach is to pair a hotfix/rollback window with compensating controls and a clear mitigation plan; Monica can outline how we've handled such incidents historically.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: (none in this message)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security materials & pen-test report request

Thanks Julia — looping in the items you requested.

Action/status: 
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (2025) uploaded to secure bucket: https://secure.redwood.com/evidence/ACME-ACCOUNTS/SOC2-2025 (read-only link, expires Apr 30).
- Full redacted pen-test report: we will share via secure expiring link once the NDA form is signed. I can provide a redacted PDF for internal review if you need it sooner.
- Vendor questionnaire: Diego will start filling answers today; I'll review the technical sections and add evidence links.

I also attached a short internal note describing our vulnerability triage and disclosure policy (summary below):
- Triage & assignment within 4 hours of detection for critical alerts; active incident channel opened for critical findings.
- Public coordinated disclosure: we notify impacted customers in incidents where customer data or impact is material; otherwise we publish advisories quarterly.
- Pen test remediation verification: for critical findings we run targeted re-tests within 72 hours after remediation is deployed.

I'll follow up with the NDA template (or sign Acme's if you drop it in HubSpot). Happy to meet — propose Apr 8 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min technical sync.

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of Security & Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
